caveat: When operated in FIPS mode. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy
description: RSA BSAFE® Crypto Module 1.1 is designed to help protect sensitive data as it is stored using strong encryption techniques to provide a persistent level of protection. The software supports a wide range of industry standard encryption algorithms offering developers the flexibility to choose the appropriate option to meet their requirements.
